result.question: What was Apple's net income in fiscal year 2025?
result.answer: Apple's net income for fiscal year 2025, which ended September 27, 2025, was $112,010 million (approximately $112.0 billion) [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p001]. This figure is also confirmed by the XBRL-tagged NetIncomeLoss fact filed with the SEC, which reports the same amount of 112,010,000,000 USD for the period ending 2025-09-27 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2025-09-27].
